title: growing awareness in the radical world of dreams!!
content: I have been extremely intrigued reading these descriptions of other people's super realistic crazy dream locations. A lot of the things people bring up are making me able to replay some of my own dreams in my head with good enough detail to kind of sort out and piece together memories of each occurrence of my reoccurring dreams, and it's been helping me a lot with better understanding what the hell is going on in my crazy dream world. Also in the short time I've been on this sub and thinking about my reoccurring dreams more, I happened to have one of my reoccurring dreams, and I came more conscious and aware in the dream than I ever have before. I feel as we all describe and discuss our dreams in detail we're going to be planting a lot of seeds in our minds that are going to help us grow a lot of awareness in our own dreams, and as we grow more awareness we will be able to test more things out in these dreams... and im super pumped about all of it!!!
